newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV WIN 6-1 TO STEAM UP TO DUTCH TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV WIN 6-1 TO STEAM UP TO DUTCH TITLE.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven steamed nearer their 14th league title when the beat Utrecht 6-1 on Saturday with a hat-trick by Belgian striker Luc Nilis.
PSV have 74 points with two matches to go, seven more than Feyenoord who have a game in hand and play Sparta Rotterdam on Monday.
A draw for Feyenoord on Monday would virtually give the title to PSV as they have a far superior goal difference.
With his three goals Nilis took the lead in the scoring list list with 20 goals. Gilles de Bilde scored twice and Boudewijn Zenden once for PSV.
Former PSV player Gerald Vanenburg picked up the consolation goal for Utrecht, who ended the match with nine players.

In the 55th minute midfielder Dick van Burik was sent off after two yellow cards, and seven minutes before time Marcel van der Net had to leave the pitch injured when three substitutes had already been used.
Former European Cup winnners and still defending champions Ajax Amsterdam beat Twente Enschede 3-2 to secure a place in the UEFA Cup for next season.
Twente took the lead in the first minute, but a Litmanen penalty and two goals by Martijn Reuser in the 82th and 84th minute made sure Ajax will be in Europe next season.

At the bottom of the table AZ Alkmaar dropped to last position after losing 4-1 to Groningen, while RKC with a 2-0 victory and NEC after beating Roda JC on Friday, moved three points clear of 18th position, the only place for direct relegation.
